transcript.answer: No, not any more. The auto-merge loop first had an `auto-merge-fix` agent (PR #3320). That agent handled red CI, conflicts and open review threads. PR #3376, merged on 2026-10-23, removed it. `auto-merge.yaml` is now `await-merge → approve → done`. A red, conflicted or thread-blocked pull request is simply waited out. Auto merge only waits and approves. The implementation loop that opened a pull request is the one that keeps it mergeable. It does this through `await-pr`/`sync-pr` and upkeep runs for settled loop PRs that are behind, conflicted or red.
